newsitem.title: USA: Servico sees Q3 net below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Servico sees Q3 net below expectations.

text.p: Hotel chain owner and operator Servico Inc said Wednesday it expects third quarter net income to be below Wall Street estimates and year-ago results.
It attributed the lower figure to hurricane and storm activity and the amortization of non-cash deferred loan costs associated with certain debt refinancings.
The company also said earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization for the quarter will be greater than in last year's third quarter and Wall Street estimates.
First Call estimate for the company's third quarter is $0.22 per share.
The company had year-ago earnings of $0.16 per share and its EBITDA for the year-ago quarter was $10.5 million, company Vice-President of Finance Warren Knight said.
The company expects to report results the week of October 21, Knight said.
